text:
Emma (Release Lead): T-minus 2h to the moonshot cutover. Quiet window begins in 30m. Quick rollcall — pins, canary %, smoke steps, rollback owners. I'm running the checklist now.

Jamal: Pin request: can we lock api -> v3.4.1 across prod? @deploy-bot please confirm.

deploy-bot: pin confirmed: service=api v=3.4.1 pinned by Emma. TTL=4h. (pin id: pin-3171717-001)

Ravi: Rollback criteria proposal: >5% 5xx aggregated across regions OR p50 latency >1s sustained for 5m OR any user-facing data corruption. Agree?

Lucy: Add one more: embeddings error-rate >1% (we've seen regressions before). If that hits, rollback immediate.

Maria: Canary currently at 3% traffic. Dashboard: https://dash.re/redwood/munin?canary=3% — Lucy, can you validate logs for the reranker path?

Lucy: Checking logs now. Smoke scripts queued: `./scripts/smoke.sh --target=canary --parallel=5`

Jamal: Who's primary rollback owner if we hit criteria? @Ravi / @Maria?

Ravi: I'll be standby. Maria will lead the rollback execution (she's oncall for infra) and I'll handle DB/migration sanity.

ops-bot: Reminder: change-window policy active — no infra changes except rollback actions. Please use ops keys for privileged commands.

Emma (Release Lead): Preflight smoke will start in 15m. If smoke passes, plan: hold canary at 3% for 40m, then shift to 20% at +40m if green, then full roll at +90m. If any rollback triggers, we stop and revert.

deploy-bot: canary deploy initiated id=deploy-3171717-canary user=Emma image=api:v3.4.1 canary=3%

Maria: Smoke started. Quick log tail: `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=api --since=10m | grep -i error` — posting output to the thread in a sec.

Lucy: smoke passed against core read/write routes. There's a minor warning from reranker: increased queue latency ~30ms, not blocking. Will observe.

Jamal: Note: frontend compatibility pin needed — frontend -> 2.8.0 to match API change. I'll pin it now.

Emma (Release Lead): Confirmed frontend pinned to 2.8.0. Add to release notes: "Frontend pinned for compatibility, remove pin after backend rollout verified."

Ravi: If we need to rollback, command (ops keys required):
```
./deploy rollback --id=deploy-3171717-canary --to=3.4.0 --reason="rollback-triggered"
```

Lucy: Also firing cached-kv warmup for canary: `curl -X POST https://internal/kv/warmup -d '{"scope":"canary"}'` so coldstarts don't skew metrics.

Maria: Canary metrics @ +12m: errors 0.3%, latency stable. No anomalous logs. Proceeding to watch until +40m.

ops-bot: Monitor created: /monitors/3171717-canary-latency and alert rule applied to #alerts with 3m aggregation.

Emma (Release Lead): If green at +40m, we shift to 20% and run a full regression smoke suite. If any of the rollback criteria fire, call #release-war-room and execute Ravi's rollback command. Keep chatter minimal during the quiet window.

Jamal: I'll draft release notes now (summary + migration notes + rollback steps) and drop in the confluence page in 10m.

Lucy: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled traffic shift: canary 3% -> 20% at ts=3171717310 (scheduled by Emma).

Maria: Acknowledged. I'll be ready to execute rollback steps if needed.

Emma (Release Lead): Thanks team — I'll post a one-line launch memo when we hit 20%. Keep phones on.
